total_funding_usd.basis: CB Insights and PitchBook aggregator profiles both state Shadeform has raised a total of $500K across ~7 investors (Y Combinator, Soma Capital, Unpopular Ventures, Translink Capital, Agile Angel, Charlotte Fund, Gravity Fund); no company or press confirmation found

note: YC company page (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/shadeform) lists the same website (https://www.shadeform.ai/, which 308-redirects to https://shadeform.com/) confirming this is the same Shadeform: YC S23, Active, founders Ed Goode (CEO) and Ronald Ding (CTO). No confirmed funding round amount/date/leads was found from primary sources (company blog, TechCrunch, HN) in the time available; funding total and revenue are aggregator estimates only (CB Insights/PitchBook/getlatka), not confirmed. Buyers should treat Shadeform as a small, YC-backed marketplace/aggregator reselling third-party GPU clouds (Hyperstack, Massed Compute, Scaleway, Lambda, etc.), not a facility operator itself.
